title: pydantic-ai
summary: Pydantic-AI is a comprehensive framework for building, orchestrating, and evaluating AI agents and applications. It provides robust integrations with various large language models, extensible tools and capabilities, and mechanisms for durable execution and performance assessment. Developers can leverage its modular design to create intelligent systems with structured outputs and reliable workflows.
